I study how to generate medical images efficiently—and how to evaluate what these models actually learn.

```{=html}
<div class="research-directions">
<section class="research-direction" id="efficiency">
<div class="direction-heading"><span class="section-number" aria-hidden="true">01</span><h2>Efficient synthesis</h2></div>
<div class="direction-body"><p class="direction-question">How can we generate high-resolution medical images with practical computational resources?</p><p>My work explores compact latent representations and diffusion models for 3D CT synthesis. Alongside image quality, I study the computational and environmental cost of training and generation.</p><div class="resource-links"><a href="publications.html#medlord">MedLoRD <i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a href="publications.html#latent-pollution">Latent Pollution Model <i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></div></div>
</section>
<section class="research-direction" id="volume-time">
<div class="direction-heading"><span class="section-number" aria-hidden="true">02</span><h2>Volume &amp; time</h2></div>
<div class="direction-body"><p class="direction-question">How can a generative model capture anatomy across both space and time?</p><p>I investigate diffusion transformers for controllable volumetric synthesis and joint 4D cardiac MRI generation, connecting spatial structure with temporal dynamics.</p><div class="resource-links"><a href="publications.html#cardiodit">CardioDiT <i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a href="publications.html#voldit">VolDiT <i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></div>

<div class="direction-heading"><span class="section-number" aria-hidden="true">03</span><h2>Evaluation beyond realism</h2></div>
<div class="direction-body"><p class="direction-question">What makes synthetic data useful beyond looking convincing?</p><p>I study diversity, anatomical variability, and patient-data memorization.
```
